# Pricing and Billing

Pay for what you use, with no markup from Hugging Face.

Free users receive $0.10, subject to change. Team organizations receive $2.00 per seat.
Monthly credits apply to routed requests. Hugging Face charges you the same rates as the provider,
with no additional fees. No separate provider account is required. Usage for the past month is
broken down by model and provider.

A Custom Provider Key means Hugging Face won't charge you for the call.

HF-Inference is billed by compute time x price of the underlying hardware.

Organization billing uses `"X-HF-Bill-To: my-org-name"`. Administrators can set a spending limit
and disable a set of Inference Providers.
